title: The Inventory of Room 214
author: Dominic Ravensworth
blurb: Marguerite Yarrow, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent fifteen years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
